readiness.hed: Fredericksburg's Wind Advisory has lifted this afternoon, with Thanksgiving Day settling into steady but lighter rain near 58 and gusts down to 26 mph, continuing into a wetter evening near 43 before Friday turns drier and breezier near 57, then a clear, sunny weekend builds in near 62 Saturday
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service's Wind Advisory for the Fredericksburg region, which had run since early this morning, expired this afternoon with no active alerts now in effect — the latest model run has backed off the strongest wind threat, with gusts easing from this morning's forecast 51 mph to near 26 mph for the rest of the holiday. Rain continues through the afternoon with a high near 58, though the precipitation chance has eased slightly to 70%, with three-quarters to one inch of additional rainfall possible. Tonight brings scattered rain showers after an evening lull, with a low near 43. Friday turns drier and breezier, mostly cloudy near 57 with gusts to 30 mph, and the weekend clears out nicely with Saturday sunny near 62.
actions: The Wind Advisory has lifted — any remaining Thanksgiving travel this evening faces lighter gusts than this morning's forecast, though rain continues into the night.
Rain showers return after dark tonight — bring in any turkey-fryer setup, decorations or outdoor seating left out from this morning if you haven't already.
Friday's wind picks back up to gusts near 30 mph under drier skies — secure light outdoor items again before heading out for Black Friday errands.
The weekend turns clear and sunny by Saturday near 62 — a good window for any outdoor cleanup or travel delayed by today's rain.
